functions.name: extractInitials

functions.name: generateSvgAvatar
functions.duty: Generates a deterministic, gradient-filled circular SVG avatar containing the user's initials when their TikTok profile photo is missing or blocked.

functions.name: fetchAvatarWithCache
functions.duty: Fetches an avatar from TikTok CDN with a 5-second abort timeout and LRU caching, falling back to a generated SVG avatar on HTTP errors or network timeouts.

functions.name: avatarProxyRouter
functions.duty: Express route handler serving avatar images with permissive CORS headers and a 24-hour cache-control header for browser WebGL textures.

functions.name: parseColorCommand
functions.duty: Parses !color chat commands, strictly resolving to one of 4 canonical Slime colors (green, red, blue, yellow) or Vietnamese aliases, and explicitly rejecting hex codes.

functions.name: sanitizeComment
functions.duty: Masks profane or sensitive words in chat messages by replacing matched characters with asterisks.

functions.name: extractUser
functions.duty: Standardizes raw TikTok user attributes into a normalized identity object containing user ID, username, nickname, and avatar URL.

functions.name: normalizeChat
functions.duty: Transforms raw chat payloads into normalized comment events, automatically extracting and attaching valid !color commands.

functions.name: normalizeGift
functions.duty: Normalizes incoming gift payloads by calculating total coin value and categorizing gifts into one of 4 hierarchical tiers.

functions.name: normalizeLike
functions.duty: Sanitizes like event counts and preserves cumulative total likes across the live session.

functions.name: normalizeSocial
functions.duty: Normalizes social stream interactions such as follows, shares, and member joins.

functions.name: normalizeTikTokEvent
functions.duty: Central dispatcher that converts any incoming raw TikTok event into a unified, timestamped event schema.

functions.name: createCustomMockUser
functions.duty: Factory helper generating mock TikTok user profile payloads with customized attributes.

functions.name: getRandomViewer
functions.duty: Selects and returns a randomized mock viewer profile from the default mock viewer pool.

functions.name: simulateLikes
functions.duty: Generates and emits a synthetic like event for testing without an active stream.

functions.name: simulateChat
functions.duty: Generates and emits a synthetic chat event with predefined or custom text.

functions.name: simulateGift
functions.params: tier = 1, customGiftName = null, customCoins = null, user = null
functions.duty: Generates and emits a synthetic gift event matching a specified gift tier.

functions.name: simulateSpawn
functions.duty: Simulates viewer entrance/spawn events with canonical color directives into the 3D room.

functions.name: startAutoSimulation
functions.duty: Starts an automated periodic timer randomly generating likes, chats, and tiered gifts.

functions.name: stopAutoSimulation
functions.duty: Clears the periodic simulation timer and halts automatic event generation.

functions.name: enqueue
functions.duty: Enqueues incoming live events, immediately bypassing Tier 2-4 VIP gifts and aggregating likes into sliding-window combos.

functions.name: flushCombo
functions.duty: Packages accumulated like combos into a single batched event and pushes it to the dispatch queue.

functions.name: drainQueue
functions.duty: Immediately flushes pending combos and drains all queued events through the dispatch callback.

functions.name: getQueueSize
functions.duty: Returns the current number of pending events held in the rate limiter queue.

functions.name: reset
functions.duty: Clears all pending events, resets the like combo accumulator, and halts running timers.

functions.name: broadcast
functions.duty: Serializes and broadcasts JSON message payloads to all currently connected WebSocket clients.

functions.name: connect
functions.duty: Establishes a real-time scraping connection to a TikTok LIVE room by username with automatic event binding.

functions.name: _bindEvents
functions.duty: Attaches internal event listeners for TikTok chat, gift, like, social, room user counts, and disconnects.

functions.name: _scheduleReconnect
functions.duty: Schedules an automatic reconnection attempt using exponential backoff when a stream drops unexpectedly.

functions.name: disconnect
functions.duty: Manually terminates the active TikTok webcast connection and cancels pending reconnect timers.

functions.name: getStatus
functions.duty: Returns the current live connection status, room ID, viewer count, and connected username.

functions.name: split3BandFrequency
functions.duty: Slices an FFT byte frequency spectrum into isolated Bass (0-150Hz), Mids (150-1000Hz), and Treble (>1000Hz) energy values.

functions.name: calculateAudioFlux
functions.duty: Computes smoothed running average energy and instantaneous positive onset flux for beat detection.

functions.name: synthesizeSfxParams
functions.duty: Provides procedural frequency, gain, and timing parameters for zero-asset sound synthesis.

functions.name: getBeatStepEvents
functions.duty: Maps a 16-step sequencer index to discrete Kick (four-on-the-floor), Snare (backbeat), and Hi-Hat triggers.

functions.name: start
functions.duty: Starts the 16-step 128 BPM loop timer and connects procedural drum voices to the audio destination.

functions.name: _playStep
functions.duty: Synthesizes swept-sine kicks, bandpass filtered snare noise, and highpass hi-hat ticks for the current sequencer step.

functions.name: stop
functions.duty: Halts the procedural drum loop and clears active step timers.

functions.name: setVolume
functions.duty: Adjusts the master gain volume level of the procedural beat engine or sound effects.

functions.name: unlockAudio
functions.duty: Resumes the browser AudioContext from suspended state upon user interaction and starts the beat synthesizer.

functions.name: init
functions.duty: Initializes Web Audio context, master gain node, and 3-band FFT analyser node upon first audio unlock.

functions.name: unlockAudio
functions.duty: Resumes the browser AudioContext from suspended state upon user interaction and starts the beat synthesizer.

functions.name: getBands
functions.duty: Reads current frequency data from the AnalyserNode and returns normalized energy and flux across 3 audio bands.

functions.name: playSfx
functions.duty: Procedurally synthesizes sound effects (coin clink, air horn, bass boom) with exponential clickless decay envelopes.

functions.name: setVolume
functions.duty: Adjusts the master gain volume level of the procedural beat engine or sound effects.

functions.name: toggleMute
functions.duty: Toggles audio master gain between muted and unmuted states.

functions.name: parseColorCommand
functions.duty: Parses chat comments for !color directives, returning a canonical Slime color definition while rejecting hex values.

functions.name: getSlimeKinematics
